description: Mark one session done and record how it went: the minutes, distance and vertical gain actually covered, feeling 1 to 5 (1 terrible, 2 hard, 3 ok, 4 good, 5 great), rpe 1 to 10 (how hard it was), tags and a note in the user's own words. The note is where what they learned from the session goes; a lesson to look up again later can also be a diary note linked to the session (add_note with session_id). Fill in only what the user said. done: false un-completes it. Requires signing in.

actual_elevation_m.description: Vertical gain actually climbed, in metres.

done.description: Default true. False un-completes the session.

notes.description: How it went, in the user's words.

rpe.description: Rate of perceived exertion, a whole number 1 to 10: 1 very easy, 3 easy, 5 hard, 7 very hard, 10 all-out.

session_id.description: id of the training session, from get_calendar, get_training_log or add_sessions.

tags.description: Tags for the session; replaces the old ones.

name: log_session
title: Log a session as done
